description: This file defines the CanEmitInline struct used for optimizing graph node emission in PyTorch's JIT interpreter, specifically for identifying nodes that can be inlined in a depth-first manner to reduce store/load/move operations.

classes.name: CanEmitInline
classes.description: A struct for analyzing a computation graph to determine which nodes can be emitted inline during code generation, based on their usage patterns and side effects.

methods.name: CanEmitInline::CanEmitInline
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the analysis by scanning the graph's block.

methods.name: CanEmitInline::canInline
methods.description: Determines if a given value's node can be inlined based on its kind and usage.

methods.name: CanEmitInline::previousNonConstant
methods.description: Finds the previous node in the list that is not a constant, skipping constants.

methods.name: CanEmitInline::scanValue
methods.description: Analyzes a value to decide if it can be inlined, and updates the inline map accordingly.

methods.name: CanEmitInline::scanNode
methods.description: Recursively scans a node and its inputs to determine inline candidates.

methods.name: CanEmitInline::scanBlock
methods.description: Scans all nodes within a block for inline candidates.
